title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Software Engineering (2015)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Software Engineering (2015). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: _____ is type of software architecture in which subsystems can act both as a client or as servers that each subsystem can request and provide services.
questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Pipe and Filter Architecture' because it allows subsystems to act as both clients and servers, facilitating service requests and provision.

questions.questionText: What kind of linked list is best to answer question like “What is the item at position n?”
questions.explanation: The 'Array implementation of linked list' is best for accessing elements at specific positions due to its direct indexing capability.

questions.questionText: Which of the following sorting compares adjacent elements in a list and switches whenever necessary?
questions.explanation: Bubble sort is characterized by comparing adjacent elements and swapping them if they are in the wrong order, making it a simple sorting algorithm.

questions.questionText: Which of the following data structures is best suited for implementing a hash table?
questions.explanation: An 'Array' is best suited for implementing a hash table because it allows for efficient indexing and storage of key-value pairs.

questions.questionText: In database state update operation, INSERT operation may violate________ constraints.
questions.explanation: INSERT operations can violate all types of constraints - domain constraints (if value doesn't match data type), key constraints (if primary key is violated), and entity integrity constraints (if required fields are missing).

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of responsive web design?
options: To enhance user experience across different devices
questions.explanation: Responsive web design aims to enhance user experience by ensuring that web pages render well on a variety of devices and window or screen sizes.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is Not an example of embedded software product?
options: Keypad control of a security system
Digital function of dashboard display in a car
questions.explanation: Pattern recognition is not typically considered an embedded software product, as it often involves more complex algorithms and processing capabilities.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not the output of the resource estimation process in project time management?
questions.explanation: Activity cost estimates are not an output of the resource estimation process; they are typically part of the budgeting process.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following tool is commonly used in almost all project KA management processes?
questions.explanation: Expert judgment is a widely used tool in project management, providing insights based on experience and knowledge.

questions.questionText: For registration use case in the User Name field the system accepts 8 to 15 alpha characters. Using BVA technique ________ will be the possible input values for the test case.
questions.explanation: Using Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), the possible input values include the boundaries and just outside the boundaries: 7, 8, 9, 14, 15, 16.

questions.questionText: Which web development technology is used for creating dynamic and interactive web pages?
questions.explanation: JavaScript is the primary technology used for creating dynamic and interactive web pages, allowing for client-side scripting.

questions.questionText: Which HTML element is used to display an image?
questions.explanation: The tag is used in HTML to embed images in a web page, allowing for the display of visual content.

questions.questionText: _____ is software design describing how the software elements, hardware elements, and end-users communicate with one another.
questions.explanation: Interface Design focuses on the interactions between software components, hardware, and users, ensuring effective communication.

questions.questionText: How is time complexity measured?
options: By counting number of operations on a given input size
By counting the input data size
By counting the number of algorithm
questions.explanation: Time complexity is primarily measured by counting the number of operations required as a function of the input size, which helps in analyzing algorithm efficiency.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following best defines Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
options: AI is a field of study that aims to solve repetitive tasks.
AI is a field of study that aims to make humans more intelligent.
AI is a field of study that aims to make intelligent machines and systems.
AI is a field of study that aims to enhance machine performance.
questions.explanation: AI is defined as the study of creating systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as understanding natural language and recognizing patterns.

questions.questionText: In a graph of n nodes and n edges, how many cycles will be present?
questions.explanation: The number of cycles in a graph with n nodes and n edges depends on the graph's structure. A graph could have multiple cycles or just one, depending on how the edges are connected.

questions.questionText: Requirement approval and customer sign-off must be conducted before the project starts, this type of relationship is?
questions.explanation: This is a 'Mandatory dependency' because it is essential for the project to proceed, ensuring that requirements are agreed upon before development begins.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a basic data type in C++?
questions.explanation: In C++, 'decimal' is not a basic data type; the basic types include int, float, and char.

questions.questionText: Routers and core switch can be used for delivering routing services. According to the OSI reference model to which layer do you categorize this network devices?
questions.explanation: Routers operate at the Network Layer of the OSI model, facilitating data routing between different networks.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a good practice during requirement change management process?
options: Communicate changes only for requirement designer, because next step is software design
Remove inconsistent requirements from a system
Documenting and Tracking changes to requirement
questions.explanation: Documenting and tracking changes is crucial in requirement change management to maintain clarity and ensure all stakeholders are informed.

questions.questionText: _____________ states primary key value must not be null value.
questions.explanation: Entity integrity ensures that the primary key in a database must always have a value, preventing null entries.

questions.questionText: What is the maximum number of return values that can be returned from a C++ function?
questions.explanation: A C++ function can return only one value directly; however, multiple values can be returned using pointers or references.

questions.questionText: In which HTML element, we put the JavaScript code?
questions.explanation: The <script> tag is used to include JavaScript code in an HTML document, allowing for dynamic content.

questions.questionText: Which of the following are not the concerns of AI that confront society?
questions.explanation: All listed options are concerns of AI; thus, 'None of these' is the correct answer.

questions.questionText: What is a common method for preventing buffer overflow vulnerabilities in software?
questions.explanation: Implementing proper input validation is essential to prevent buffer overflow vulnerabilities by ensuring that inputs are within expected limits.

questions.questionText: In case of a large search space, which search strategy would be preferred?
questions.explanation: Informed search strategies use heuristics to guide the search process, making them more efficient in large search spaces.

questions.questionText: Which of the following data structures is best suited for implementing a priority queue?
questions.explanation: A Heap is the most efficient data structure for implementing a priority queue, allowing for quick access to the highest (or lowest) priority element.

questions.questionText: Among the event handling mechanisms in android, which option is better to handle more complex kinds of events?
questions.explanation: Using event listener interfaces provides a more flexible and powerful way to handle complex events in Android applications.

questions.questionText: Which of the following can be a multivalued attribute?
questions.explanation: A Phone-number can be a multivalued attribute as a person may have multiple phone numbers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a C++ operator used for multiplication?
questions.explanation: The '*' operator is used in C++ for multiplication operations.

questions.questionText: The structural evolutionary prototyping model of software development process is
options: The best approach to use for projects with large development teams
It is not important for creating awareness of additional needed functionality
reasonable approach when requirement is well defined
useful approach when a customer cannot define requirements clearly
questions.explanation: The structural evolutionary prototyping model is particularly useful when customers have difficulty defining their requirements clearly, allowing for iterative development.

questions.questionText: Among the following, one is the scope of product development life cycle (PDLC)?
questions.explanation: System design is a critical aspect of the product development life cycle, focusing on how the system will be structured and function.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is false about round robin scheduling algorithm?
options: Characterized by using quantum number for the scheduling
It's the fairest algorithm and most widely used algorithm.
questions.explanation: The statement about round robin scheduling being non-preemptive is false; it is actually a preemptive scheduling algorithm.

questions.questionText: In a system using virtual memory, the physical memory is divided into ________ and the virtual address space is divided into equally-sized partitions called_______.
questions.explanation: In virtual memory systems, physical memory is divided into 'Page frames' while the virtual address space is divided into 'pages'.

questions.questionText: Which one of the followings is/are Incorrect about first normal forms?
options: It is used to disallow the multivalued attributes
Composite attributes cannot be used in 1NF
Relations can be created in a relation
The only attribute values allowed are atomic values
questions.explanation: The statement 'Relations can be created in a relation' is incorrect as first normal form (1NF) requires that all attributes contain only atomic values.

questions.questionText: What is the role of back-end technology in web development?
options: To handle client-side operations and user interactions
To implement the visual design of a website
To ensure compatibility across different web browsers
To manage server-side operations and database interactions
questions.explanation: Back-end technology is responsible for managing server-side operations, including database interactions and application logic.

questions.questionText: Which class does the IP address 172.16 1.20 belongs to?
questions.explanation: The IP address 172.16.1.20 belongs to Class B, which is characterized by a default subnet mask of 255.255.0.0.

questions.questionText: Alpha testing is:
options: Post-release testing by end user representatives at the developer's site
Post-release testing by testing team at the developer's site
Pre-release testing by end user representatives at their sites
Pre-release testing by testing team at the developer's site
questions.explanation: Alpha testing is conducted by the testing team at the developer's site before the software is released to end users.

questions.questionText: A started service will in a running state when one of the following service life cycle method is invoked
questions.explanation: The method 'onStartCommand()' is invoked to start a service and put it into a running state in Android.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is Not True?
options: Coupling is the level of inter-dependability among modules.
Cohesive module focuses on a single function.
If two modules are tightly coupled, one can function completely without the presence of other.
Abstraction is the process of creating a detailed design specification for each component of a system.
questions.explanation: The statement is false; tightly coupled modules cannot function independently, as they rely on each other.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements is Not correct?
options: test set that achieves 100% branch coverage will also achieve 100% statement coverage.
minimal test set that achieves 100% branch coverage will generally detect more faults than one that achieves 100% statement coverage.
minimal test set that achieves 100% statement coverage will generally detect more faults than one that achieves 100% branch coverage.
questions.explanation: The statement is incorrect; achieving 100% statement coverage does not guarantee that all branches have been tested.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of threat modeling in software security?
options: To identify potential threats and vulnerabilities in software
To test the functionality of the software
To validate the software against industry standards
To document the software for future reference
questions.explanation: Threat modeling is a proactive approach to identify and mitigate potential security threats and vulnerabilities in software.

questions.questionText: For some relations, changing the data can have undesirable consequences called
questions.explanation: Modification anomalies occur when changes to data lead to inconsistencies or unintended consequences in a database.

questions.questionText: The ___________ operation, allows us to find tuples that are in one relation but are not in another.
questions.explanation: The 'Set-difference' operation retrieves tuples that exist in one relation but not in another, effectively filtering out common entries.

questions.questionText: What is a typical threat to software security?
questions.explanation: Malware is a significant threat to software security, as it can compromise systems, steal data, and disrupt operations.

questions.questionText: What does the following relational algebra expression do? σ amount > 1200 (Loan)
options: Finds all the tuples in Loan
Retrieve the amount attribute in Loan where the amount is greater than 1200
Finds all the tuples in Loan where the amount is greater than 1200
questions.explanation: The expression σ amount > 1200 (Loan) selects all tuples from the Loan relation where the amount exceeds 1200.

questions.questionText: Variables defined inside methods, constructors or blocks are called _____.
questions.explanation: Local variables are defined within methods or blocks and are only accessible within that scope.

questions.questionText: ____________ is a process in which an overridden method is called through the reference variable of super class.
questions.explanation: Method overriding allows a subclass to provide a specific implementation of a method that is already defined in its superclass.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of the << operator in C++?
options: To input data from the keyboard
To output data to the console
To perform a logical AND operation
questions.explanation: The << operator is used in C++ for outputting data to the console, commonly used with streams.

questions.questionText: ________ is a description of a kind of object.
questions.explanation: A Class in programming is a blueprint for creating objects, defining their properties and behaviors.

questions.questionText: Open System Interconnection model is an example of________ architecture.
questions.explanation: The OSI model is a layered architecture that standardizes the functions of a telecommunication or computing system.

questions.questionText: Which protocol is commonly used in the client-server architecture for web-based applications?
questions.explanation: HTTP is the foundational protocol used for transmitting data over the web, enabling communication between clients and servers.

questions.questionText: Which of the following cable can be used to interconnect two computers for formulating peer to peer network?
questions.explanation: A Cross over cable is used to connect two computers directly, allowing for peer-to-peer networking.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is used to execute a specific block of code based on the value of a variable or expression in C++?
questions.explanation: The switch statement allows for executing different blocks of code based on the value of a variable, providing a cleaner alternative to multiple if statements.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is an example of stakeholder in requirement engineering?
questions.explanation: All listed options are stakeholders in requirement engineering, as they all have a vested interest in the project's outcome.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a type of loop in C++?
questions.explanation: The 'repeat loop' is not a recognized loop type in C++; the valid types are while, for, and do-while loops.

questions.questionText: Which design pattern is commonly used in the client-server architecture to decouple the client application from server-specific implementation details?
questions.explanation: The Adapter Pattern is used to allow incompatible interfaces to work together, decoupling the client from the server's implementation.

questions.questionText: The part of operating system that is responsible for managing the memory hierarchy in computer system is called _____________.
questions.explanation: The Memory Manager is responsible for handling memory allocation and deallocation, ensuring efficient use of memory resources.

questions.questionText: The android.graphics package has support for
questions.explanation: The android.graphics package provides classes for drawing and manipulating graphics, including Canvas, Bitmap, and Paint.

questions.questionText: Which component in the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architectural pattern is responsible for interacting with the data source?
questions.explanation: The Model component in MVC is responsible for managing the data and business logic, interacting with the data source.

questions.questionText: If a class has multiple methods having the same name but different parameters, it is called ______________.
questions.explanation: Method overloading allows a class to have multiple methods with the same name but different parameter lists, enhancing flexibility.

questions.questionText: A diagramming analysis technique used to select the best course of action when future outcomes are uncertain is?
questions.explanation: A Decision tree is a visual representation of decisions and their possible consequences, helping to analyze potential outcomes.

questions.questionText: As ______________________ operating system is responsible for allocating resources to the various applications so that access to the resources is synchronized and operations are correct and consistent.
questions.explanation: A resource manager in an operating system allocates resources to applications, ensuring synchronized access and correct operations.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is limitations of the manual approach?
questions.explanation: The manual approach has several limitations, including data dependency, lengthy development times, and data redundancy.

questions.questionText: An entity that does not have a key attribute and that is identification-dependent on another entity type:
questions.explanation: A Weak entity type is one that cannot be uniquely identified by its own attributes alone and relies on a related entity.

questions.questionText: Which design pattern is used to provide a way of handling a request by passing it through a series of handlers until it is handled or rejected?
questions.explanation: The Chain of Responsibility Pattern allows multiple handlers to process a request, passing it along the chain until one handles it.

questions.questionText: The main concern of performance quality attributes is_____.
questions.explanation: Latency is a critical performance quality attribute, referring to the delay before a transfer of data begins following an instruction.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a type of function that is expanded in place at the point of call in C++?
questions.explanation: An Inline function is expanded in place at the point of call, which can improve performance by eliminating function call overhead.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a back-end technology?
questions.explanation: PHP is a server-side scripting language used for back-end development, allowing for dynamic content generation and database interaction.

questions.questionText: During a software testing process, what happened if an expected result is not specified?
options: It may be difficult to run the test
It may be difficult to determine if the test has passed or failed
We cannot automate the user input values
We cannot determine the actual result
questions.explanation: Without an expected result, it becomes challenging to assess the outcome of a test, making it hard to determine if the test has passed or failed.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is true?
options: Manual testing uses automation tools to execute test cases.
No need for programming skills in automation testing.
Manual testing is suitable for exploratory testing
The initial investment in Automation testing is lower than in manual testing.
questions.explanation: Manual testing is indeed suitable for exploratory testing, where testers actively explore the application to identify issues.

questions.questionText: _____________ states primary key value must not be null value.
questions.explanation: Entity integrity ensures that every primary key in a database must have a value, preventing null entries.

questions.questionText: The TCP port number 23 describes about the _________.
options: Transmission of file from one client to the other one at the presence of FTP service
The mailing service delivered by using the SMTP
Remote login capability which can be achieved by using the telnet
questions.explanation: TCP port number 23 is associated with Telnet, which provides remote login capabilities to networked devices.

questions.questionText: Unsupervised learning methods can be used in which one of the following scenarios?
options: Given a set of news articles found on the web, group them into a set of articles about the same story.
Given a dataset of reviews of Netflix movie series marked as positive, negative and neutral, classify reviews of a new Netflix movie series.
Given a dataset of emails labeled as spam or not spam, and classify new incoming emails to their right classes.
Given a dataset of patients diagnosed as either having diabetes or not, learn to classify new patients as having diabetes or not.
questions.explanation: Unsupervised learning is suitable for grouping data without predefined labels, such as clustering news articles based on content.

questions.questionText: Among the reasons that lead to deadlock in operating system which one is used to be solution for the inter process communication problem?
questions.explanation: Mutual exclusion is a condition that can lead to deadlock; however, it is also a necessary condition for resource allocation in many systems.

questions.questionText: The TCP/IP Host to Host network layer corresponds to the ___________ layer of the OSI reference model.
questions.explanation: The Transport layer in the OSI model corresponds to the Host to Host layer in the TCP/IP model, responsible for end-to-end communication.

questions.questionText: Identify the slowest sorting technique among the following?
questions.explanation: Bubble sort is generally considered the slowest sorting algorithm due to its O(n^2) time complexity, making it inefficient for large datasets.

questions.questionText: What is the primary goal of software security?
options: To prevent unauthorized access and protect against attacks
questions.explanation: The primary goal of software security is to prevent unauthorized access and protect systems from attacks, ensuring data integrity and confidentiality.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not true about an intelligent agent?
options: The intelligent agent needs user input for solving any problem.
The intelligent agent can be an autonomous entity.
The intelligent agent is the rational agent.
The intelligent agents can solve a problem on its own without any human intervention.
questions.explanation: An intelligent agent can operate autonomously and solve problems without user input, making the first statement incorrect.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of a security policy?
options: To prevent all security breaches from occurring
To provide guidance on how to protect information assets
To guarantee complete security of all information assets
To restrict access to all information assets
questions.explanation: A security policy provides a framework for protecting information assets by outlining procedures and guidelines for security practices.

questions.questionText: Suppose you have a function that takes in a list of integers and returns the maximum value in the list. The function also prints a message to the console with the maximum value. How many test cases do you need to achieve 100% statement coverage?
questions.explanation: To achieve 100% statement coverage, at least two test cases are needed: one for a list with multiple integers and one for an empty list.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not the application of data structure?
questions.explanation: All listed options are applications of data structures; hence, 'None of the above mentioned' is the correct answer.

questions.questionText: When the switch statement matches the expression with the given labels, how is the comparison done?
options: Both the datatype and the result of the expression are compared.
Only the datatype of the expression is compared
Only the value of the expression is compared
questions.explanation: In a switch statement, both the datatype and the value of the expression are compared to the case labels to determine which block of code to execute.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not an application of AI?
questions.explanation: Database Management Systems are not considered applications of AI; they are systems for managing data, while the other options involve AI techniques.

questions.questionText: Which design principle suggests that software should be designed in such a way that the different components can be easily changed without affecting other components?
questions.explanation: Low coupling is a design principle that promotes minimal dependencies between components, allowing for easier changes and maintenance.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a Not a characteristic of good design?
options: Software engineer must design the modules with the goal of high cohesion and low coupling
software engineer must design the modules with the goal of low cohesion and high coupling
design must implement all explicit requirements from the analysis model and accommodate all implicit requirements desired by the user
questions.explanation: Designing modules with low cohesion and high coupling is not a characteristic of good design; good design aims for high cohesion and low coupling.

questions.questionText: Among the following which one is not reasons for introducing the concepts of EER model?
options: It avoids describing similar concepts more than once.
It adds more semantic information to the design.
questions.explanation: All listed reasons are valid for introducing EER models; thus, 'None' is the correct answer.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not true about project risk management, which one is it?
options: Positive risks are known as threats
Risk management can have positive impact on selecting projects
Risk management can often result in significant improvements in the ultimate success of projects
questions.explanation: Positive risks are not threats; they represent opportunities that can benefit the project if managed correctly.

questions.questionText: The string _______ method compares values lexicographically and returns an integer value.
questions.explanation: The compareTo() method in Java compares two strings lexicographically and returns an integer indicating their relative order.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is time multiplexed resource?
questions.explanation: The CPU is a time-multiplexed resource, allowing multiple processes to share the CPU by rapidly switching between them.

questions.questionText: Which one of the followings is/are Incorrect about first normal forms?
options: It is used to disallow the multivalued attributes
Composite attributes cannot be used in 1NF
Relations can be created in a relation
The only attribute values allowed are atomic values
questions.explanation: The statement 'Relations can be created in a relation' is incorrect as first normal form (1NF) requires that all attributes contain only atomic values.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is Not categorized under Product Operation of McCall's Software Quality Factors?
questions.explanation: Reusability is not categorized under Product Operation in McCall's Software Quality Factors; it focuses on how well software can be reused in different contexts.

questions.questionText: In android studio, the file which contains list of application permissions and configuration is
questions.explanation: The android manifest file contains essential information about the application, including permissions and configuration settings.

questions.questionText: In android studio file structure, the file which is used to register minSdk, targetSdk and app dependencies is
questions.explanation: The Build.gradle file is used to specify the minimum SDK version, target SDK version, and dependencies for the Android application.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of vulnerability scanning in software security?
options: To identify potential vulnerabilities in software
To test the functionality of the software
To validate the software against industry standards
To document the software for future reference
questions.explanation: Vulnerability scanning is conducted to identify potential security weaknesses in software, allowing for proactive remediation.

questions.questionText: With use of extends keyword the subclasses will be able to inherit all the properties of the super class except _____.
questions.explanation: Subclasses inherit all properties of the superclass except for private members, which are not accessible outside the superclass.

questions.questionText: The model which would use the divide and conquer approach is _____________.
questions.explanation: The Incremental Development Model uses a divide and conquer approach by breaking down the project into smaller, manageable increments.

questions.questionText: Which of the following network topology is referenced as an active network topology?
questions.explanation: Ring Topology is considered an active topology because each device is connected in a circular fashion, and data travels in one direction, requiring active devices to manage the data flow.

questions.questionText: An android component which listens to android system wide events and notifies the arrival of a new message can be
questions.explanation: A Broadcast receiver is an Android component that listens for system-wide broadcast announcements and can respond to them, such as receiving new messages.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a requirement for a C++ function to be recursive?
questions.explanation: Dynamic variables are not a requirement for recursion; a recursive function must have a base case and a recursive case to function correctly.
